title: Quantum Process Realization of LDPC Code Dualities and Product Constructions
summary: We realize a broad class of code transformations, including Kramers-Wannier duality, tensor product, and check product, as quantum processes consisting of ancilla initialization, local unitaries, and projective measurements. Using ZX-calculus, we formulate these code transformations diagrammatically and develop a systematic algorithm for extracting their quantum-process realizations.
